svg.title: Joint certificate: proved global structure, conditional clipped transfer
svg.desc: Manual proof dependencies for TASK-20261030-6394ed. Global monic ideal powers and formal N decomposition are proved. Actual clipped ranks, prime-specialization packet, integer span and extraction remain missing. No scientific values are plotted.

g.text: Exact joint ideal: one modulus, three shared-variable equations
TASK-20261030-6394ed | manual derivation | independent review pending | zero scientific calls
PROVED: global ideal powers
Auxiliary weights (2,2,2,2,1,1)
Monic coprime leading terms; products give G_j
All I^j quotients free over Z[c]; p-saturation
PROVED: formal N-module
H_j = I^j intersect span(M), r_j = dim H_j
N-coefficients in nested joint ideal powers
q_N = mu*d - sum(r_j); no ranks evaluated
CONDITIONAL: actual clipped-flag specialization packet is missing
Remainder matrices T_j; shared adapted B and inverse; left-inverse tails; p-unit minors Delta(c0)
Global flatness does not preserve coordinate clipping: (x+c*y), V=span{x} is the exact control.
Bound-order/native trace, integer representatives and complete span are separate checks.
IF certified and N0=p: full integer p-primary lattice index = p^q_N
Usable budget = sum(r_j); four X scales and two Y scales; selected rows may have extra index m.
Explicit saturation can remove unit-index factors; certify equality, actual heights and construction cost.
OPEN: changing-packet uniform heights, short equations, extraction, group relations, IC cost
Ryan Heuristics 1/2 remain assumptions. No reach, root, IC gain or family closure follows here.
Solid green = manual algebra proof. Dashed = additional finite hypotheses. Source: joint-certificate.md, Lemmas U/F/C/P.
